# Sommers Roth & Elmaleh

> Canadian medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, pediatric negligence, and civil litigation with expertise in obstetric and neonatal cases.

Sommers Roth & Elmaleh is a Toronto-based law firm founded by Richard J. Sommers (Queen's Counsel) and Robert Roth, with offices across Canada. The firm represents clients in complex medical negligence cases involving birth injuries, pediatric malpractice, midwife negligence, and hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), with lawyers recognized by Lexpert and affiliated with leading Canadian legal institutions.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Medical Negligence
- Birth Injury
- Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)
- Pediatric Malpractice

- Midwife Malpractice
- Civil Litigation
- Cerebral Palsy
